sentences.text: Let’s check a compass on a range.
The chart shows the range line at zero four two true.
Variation is six west, and going from true toward magnetic you add west, so the magnetic direction is zero four eight.
Lined up on the range, your compass reads zero five one.
The compass reads three degrees more than magnetic, so the deviation on this heading is three degrees west.
Record it on your deviation card for that heading.
